name: Isla Cristina (Spain)
description: Two yellow stripes above and below seven narrow stripes alternating white and blue across the centre, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Isla Cristina (a well, a fig tree and waves).
history: The flag of Isla Cristina was approved by the municipal council on 31 May 1969; it is formed of two yellow stripes representing the sun and seven alternating white and blue bars representing the air and the sea, four white and three blue. The arms show a well, from which water was drawn in the first days of the settlement, and a fig tree.
